name: WOOD PROJECT DESIGNS
niche: cabinet maker / custom cabinetry & fine woodworking
own_site_check_result: No DNS record (NXDOMAIN) for any tested domain variant. Web search for the exact business name plus Miami/Kendall/Eduardo/the phone number surfaced no official website, Instagram, or Facebook page for this specific business (only unrelated cabinet shops with similar generic names). Confirmed: no own website, no social media presence found.

hours.source: Google Maps business listing, captured live via Playwright on 2026-11-15.

language_evidence: All 5 captured Google reviews are written in English by the reviewers. The owner's (Eduardo) replies to reviews are shown by Google as 'Translated by Google - See original (Spanish)', indicating the owner's original language is Spanish, consistent with the Google 'Identifies as Latino-owned' tag. Site built bilingual EN/ES with EN as the default language per the review-language evidence; ES available via the toggle for Spanish-speaking visitors.
research_method: Playwright (Chromium headless) used to open the live Google Maps listing directly: confirmed rating, exact review count, address, phone, hours, and the absence of a 'Website' button (shows 'Add website' instead). Clicked into the Photos panel and scrolled to collect photo URLs (lh3.googleusercontent.com), and into the Reviews tab to capture verbatim review text and author names from the rendered DOM.

review_samples.name: Salette Guillen
review_samples.quote: Eduardo & his team redid our kitchen, closets, and bathroom cabinets and we couldn't be more happy with the results. From start to finish they demonstrated professionalism, attention to detail, and commitment to quality that exceeded our expectations. Highly recommend!!

review_samples.name: Barbara Pazos
review_samples.quote: I had an amazing experience with Wood Project. Their service was extremely professional, and courteous during the entire project. The kitchen cabinet is exactly what I had imagine. I love my new kitchen. I would highly recommend them. Than you Eduardo and staff.

review_samples.name: Will
review_samples.quote: Eduardo and his assistants are fantastic and very professional. Their work is impeccable very well done . Highly recommend them

review_samples.name: Maytee Gonzalez
review_samples.quote: We were very pleased and impressed with the quality and promptness of the work in our kitchen cabinets. We love them!

review_samples.name: Yadier Zarabozo
review_samples.quote: Best cabinetry company, recommended 100% arriba varadero

pricing: Not published. Site uses variant adapted per PIPELINE.md Fase 3.5: no exact prices shown, every service CTA leads to a free quote by phone/text ('quoted per project').

evidence: Address on the live Google Maps listing: 12019 SW 117th Ct, Miami, FL 33186 (Kendall neighborhood, Miami-Dade County).
Phone area code 786 is a Miami-Dade, FL area code.
Exterior photo found in the business's Google photo gallery shows a loading-dock style workshop door numbered '12019', matching the listed street address.

photos.source: Google Maps business photo gallery (lh3.googleusercontent.com URLs), extracted with Playwright after opening the Photos panel and scrolling to lazy-load more thumbnails. Downloaded via curl with a Chrome user agent, verified as real JPEGs with PIL (Python), resized to max 1000px wide at quality 82.

A generic Google 'W' placeholder tile that is not a real business photo

template_base: templates/dark/index.html (Mizu dark example), re-themed with a brass/bronze wood-tone palette instead of champagne gold
build_variant: Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5: no exact pricing (quoted per project / free estimate), phone + SMS based CTAs only (no WhatsApp, since it was not verified as an active channel for this number), real street address used for an embedded Google Maps iframe since the business publishes its workshop address on its Google Business Profile.
notes: No email, Instagram or Facebook found after deep research; this is a Google-only presence. CTA channels are call and SMS to +1 786-325-1410. 'Se habla espanol' / bilingual framing on the site is grounded in two pieces of real evidence: Google's 'Identifies as Latino-owned' tag on the listing, and the owner's (Eduardo) review replies being shown by Google as translated from Spanish.
